description: Free. Check whether an x402 endpoint or MCP tool is real, payable and active BEFORE you pay it. Pass a URL; get a 0–100 payability score, the listed price and networks, when it was last active (for paid listings, the last settled payment), and flags for catalog-flooding or outlier pricing. Scored from the public PayAI x402 Bazaar + MCP Registry index — listings are third-party data, not endorsed. Returns a 0–100 score, a verdict (payable / mixed / unverified), the listed price, networks and last-active date, plain-language signals, and provider flooding / price-outlier warnings.

maxPriceUsd.description: What you expect to pay per call, in US dollars. If the listed price is higher you'll be warned.

url.description: The endpoint URL (or host) you're about to pay — e.g. 'https://api.example.com/v1/search'.

name: check_payability
title: Check if an endpoint is payable before you pay it
